about.title: Building a Responsible Investment Future with AI.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Modcus was founded with the belief that every investor, whether beginner or professional, deserves equal access to world-class financial analysis tools. Our mission is to democratize capital market information in Indonesia through advanced AI technology that is transparent and easy to use.
mission.p2: We strive to eliminate complex information barriers and present them in actionable insights, empowering individuals to make smarter and more confident investment decisions.

principles.title: Our Principles
principles.subtitle: Our approach to building AI is based on the following core principles.

security.title: Data Security & Privacy
security.description: We prioritize user data security as the main foundation. All analysis is performed while fully protecting your privacy.

objectivity.title: Objectivity & Transparency
objectivity.description: Our AI models are designed to provide objective analysis based on data, free from bias and conflicts of interest.

empowerment.title: Investor Empowerment
empowerment.description: Our ultimate goal is education. We want to empower investors with the knowledge to navigate the market independently.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: We bring together experts from various fields to build reliable and beneficial AI systems.

research.title: Research & AI Team
research.description: This team is the heart of Modcus innovation. They consist of AI researchers and quantitative financial analysts tasked with developing and training our machine learning models. Their focus is on prediction accuracy, understanding the Indonesian market context, and ensuring the analysis produced is relevant and accountable.

engineering.title: Engineering & Product Team
engineering.description: Responsible for translating complex research into a reliable, fast, and easy-to-use platform. This team builds data infrastructure, designs user interfaces (UI/UX), and ensures the security and scalability of the Modcus platform to serve millions of investors across Indonesia.

operations.title: Operations & Partnerships Team
operations.description: This team ensures all company operations run smoothly, from user support to business development. They are the frontline in listening to user feedback and building strategic partnerships with financial institutions and investor communities to expand reach and positive impact of Modcus.

cta.title: Partner With Us
cta.subtitle: We are open to collaboration with financial institutions, securities companies, and media to create a better investment ecosystem. Let's discuss.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: PT Ngoper Global Infinity ("Modcus", "we", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect several types of information:

items.account: Account Information: Name and email address
items.usage: Usage Information: Data about how you use our services
items.technical: Technical Information: IP address, browser type, and device
items.cookies: Cookies: Data stored on your device to improve experience

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the collected information to:

items.communicate: Communicate with you about our services
items.security: Detect and prevent fraud or abuse

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. We only share your information in the following situations:

items.providers: With third-party service providers who assist our operations
items.protect: To protect our rights and safety or others

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of internet transmission is 100% secure.

storage.title: 6. Data Retention
storage.content: We retain your personal data as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

items.object: Object to processing of your data

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your experience. You can set your browser to refuse cookies, but this may affect the functionality of our services.

thirdParty.title: 9. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our services may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites. We encourage you to read their privacy policies.

changes.title: 10. Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights, please contact us at:
